Same contract address appears at call depth N and N+2 or deeper in same tx. Core geometric fingerprint of reentrancy.
call_count > 1 AND depth_spread >= 2 AND same to_address at min 2 depths

Same victim contract at multiple depths but different function selectors each time. Deposit inside withdraw.
same to_address at depth N and N+2 AND func_selector differs between appearances

value_eth > 0 at each depth where same address re-appears
Contract balance mapping NOT updated between successive calls in same tx. The fundamental reentrancy bug.
tokensReceived() or equivalent called before initiating transfer completes. ERC777 reentrancy entry.
func_selector matches tokensReceived AND call_depth > depth of initiating transfer

Proxy Pattern Normal Operation
DELEGATECALL detected in execution trace + storage slots modified = delegatecall_storage_write fires

Flash Loan Legitimate Use
flashloan_bracket_detected fires + large_value_inflow_spike + drain_ratio_exceeded
Flash loans are used legitimately for arbitrage, collateral swaps, self-liquidation. Repayment at tx end is the defining feature of LEGITIMATE use.

Check net effect on OTHER contracts. Legitimate flash loan: no OTHER contract loses funds. Attack: a victim contract net balance decreases. Require drain_ratio_exceeded on victim (not just borrower) to confirm.
flashloan_bracket_detected, drain_ratio_exceeded, large_value_inflow_spike
AMM Concentrated Liquidity Removal
liquidity_removal_spike fires when LP removes large concentrated liquidity position
Uniswap V3 / concentrated liquidity positions can represent >80% of pool range. Legitimate LPs removing their own position triggers this signal.
Check if remover address matches original LP provider address. Check time between LP deposit and removal — slow rug takes days, legitimate removal can be immediate but from known address.

Same router address appears at multiple depths = recursive_depth_pattern may fire
DEX aggregators (1inch, Paraswap) and routers legitimately route through multiple pools. Router address appears at depth 0, 2, 4 across hops.
Whitelist known router and aggregator addresses. Check if to_address is whitelisted router. Require that the repeated address is NOT the tx_from (attacker sends to victim, not router to itself).

Privileged function called + ownership patterns = ownership_transfer_then_drain may fire
Properly governed protocols execute proposals through timelocks. The execution call looks like a privileged action but was voted on days earlier.
Check governance_actions log for proposal created N days before execution. Require zero governance_actions evidence before flagging ownership attacks. Timelock contracts should be whitelisted.

value_dispersion fires — single address sending to many fresh addresses
Token airdrops, NFT mints, salary distributions all send to many fresh addresses in short windows.

Check if sender is known protocol or deployer address. Check if value per recipient is uniform (airdrop pattern) vs irregular (laundering pattern). Cross-reference with token transfer events vs raw ETH.

large_value_inflow_spike fires on a large DeFi deposit
Wealthy users (whales) make large deposits into DeFi protocols. 10x baseline threshold fires on first large deposit from new whale.

11 Glossary: ChainSentinel — Glossary of Terms (Plain English for All Audiences)
Plain English definitions for all technical terms used in this document. Written for both technical and non-technical readers.
Term
Plain English Meaning
Technical Context
Appears In Sheet
ABI (Application Binary Interface)
The instruction manual for a smart contract. Tells you what functions exist, what inputs they take, and what events they emit.
Required to decode raw hex topic0 hashes into human-readable event names. Without ABI events are unreadable hex strings.
Archive Node
An Ethereum node that keeps complete history of every state change ever made. More expensive than a standard node.
Required for call_traces_raw, balance_diffs, storage_diffs, state_diffs. Standard nodes only serve recent state.
BFS (Breadth-First Search)
A method of exploring a network layer by layer. Used to trace how funds move through addresses hop by hop.
Used in fund_hop_chains to trace stolen ETH from attacker through intermediate wallets to final destination.
Call Depth / Call Tree
When a contract calls another contract that creates a depth. Depth 0 is the original tx. Reentrancy creates abnormal depth patterns.
execution_structure records every call with its depth. recursive_depth_pattern fires when same address appears at multiple depths.
DELEGATECALL
Contract A borrows Contract B's code but runs it in A's own storage. Like a contractor working in your office with access to all your files.
Used legitimately in proxy patterns. Exploited when attacker points it at malicious code to rewrite victim's admin slots.
Depth Spread
Difference between max and min call depths for the same address in one tx. Spread of 6 (depths 0,2,4,6) = strong reentrancy indicator.
Computed in execution_structure. recursive_depth_pattern threshold: depth_spread >= 2 AND call_count > 1.
Drain Ratio
Percentage of a contract's balance removed in a single tx. Ratio of 0.95 means 95% of funds taken out.
Computed in value_flow_intra_tx as total_out_eth / balance_at_tx_start. drain_ratio_exceeded fires when > 0.80.
Ethereum standard specifying which storage slot a proxy contract uses to store its implementation address.
proxy_implementation_change checks EIP-1967 slot specifically. If this slot changes, proxy was upgraded or attacked.
EIP-2612 / Permit
Extension allowing users to approve token spending via off-chain signature instead of separate on-chain tx.
permit_usage_log captures all permit() calls. Phished permit signature can drain wallet without prior on-chain approval.
ERC20
Most common Ethereum token standard. Defines transfer, approve, transferFrom, balanceOf.
Most DeFi exploits involve ERC20 tokens. token_transfer_graph and approval_registry track ERC20 movements.
ERC4626
Standard for tokenised vaults. Defines share minting/burning and asset tracking. Vulnerable to inflation attacks.
share_price_history tracks ERC4626 share price per block. donation_inflation_attack and vault_inflation_attack target this.
ERC777
Advanced token standard with hooks — callbacks firing on recipient when tokens are received.
hook_callback_detected watches for tokensReceived() called before transfer completes. ERC777 Hook Reentrancy attack family.
Event Log / Topic0
When a contract emits an event Ethereum stores it as a log. Topic0 is the keccak256 hash of the event signature — unreadable without ABI.
event_logs_raw contains raw topic0 values. decode_logs.py uses ABI to translate topic0 into readable event names.
Flash Loan
A loan borrowed and repaid within the exact same transaction. No collateral needed — blockchain guarantees repayment or tx reverts.
flashloan_bracket_detected identifies borrow-use-repay structure. Flash loan alone is not an attack.
Function Selector
First 4 bytes of keccak256 hash of a function signature. Identifies which function is being called.
transactions_raw contains raw selectors as hex (e.g. 0xa9059cbb = transfer). ABI decoding translates to function names.
Heuristic
A rule-based detection method. Not 100% guaranteed but reliably identifies suspicious patterns. Like a smoke detector.
Layer 1 structural heuristics read the geometry of call traces without needing to understand contract logic.
Keccak256
Hashing algorithm Ethereum uses. Takes any input and produces a fixed 32-byte output.
abi_extractor.py computes keccak256 of event signatures to build signature_db.json used by decode_logs.py.
MEV (Maximal Extractable Value)
Profit extracted by controlling transaction order within a block. Bots exploit this via sandwich attacks and frontrunning.
block_address_activity derived log captures tx ordering needed to detect sandwich and frontrunning.
Nonce
Counter tracking how many transactions an address has sent. Starts at 0 for new addresses.
nonce_tracking monitors progression. Fresh address (nonce=0) attacking a complex protocol is a strong attacker signal.
Oracle
Service bringing external data like prices onto the blockchain. Smart contracts cannot access the internet directly.
price_reads captures every oracle call. Oracle manipulation family covers AMM spot price, TWAP, multi-oracle attacks.
Proxy Contract
Thin contract delegating all logic to a separate implementation contract. Proxy holds storage; implementation holds logic.
proxy_implementation_change watches for implementation slot changing. Uninitialized proxy exploit targets proxies whose initialize() was never called.
Reentrancy
When a contract calls an external address and that address calls back before the first call finished. The most classic DeFi vulnerability.
execution_structure and state_delta_per_tx together detect this. The DAO hack (2016, $60M) is the landmark example.
SELFDESTRUCT
EVM opcode destroying a contract and sending all its ETH to a target. Bypasses all withdrawal logic, emits no standard events.
selfdestruct_detected watches for this in execution_structure. No Withdrawn event — missing_expected_event also fires.
TWAP (Time-Weighted Average Price)
Price calculated as average over a time period. Harder to manipulate than spot price.
twap_drift_detected watches for sustained directional swaps across multiple blocks gradually moving TWAP.
State Diff
Complete record of what changed in Ethereum state as result of a transaction — storage, balances, nonces.
storage_diffs, balance_diffs, state_diffs are all state diff types. state_delta_per_tx computes critical before/after deltas.
Confidence Weight
Number assigned to each signal indicating how strongly it indicates an attack on its own. W3=conclusive, W2=needs support, W1=context only.
Attack correlator sums weights of all fired signals. Confirmed when sum >= threshold. Classic Reentrancy threshold = 7/11.
Address Clustering
Grouping multiple addresses likely controlled by same entity based on behavioural patterns or common funding.
address_cluster_identified signal. address_interaction_graph and contract_creator_graph are the feeding derived logs.
